description: Source code for 'otrx' utility handling TRX firmware images, including functions for checking, creating, and extracting TRX files, with CRC32 checksum calculations and header management.

methods.name: otrx_crc32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum over a buffer.

methods.name: otrx_check
methods.description: Validates a TRX file by checking magic, length, and CRC32.

methods.name: otrx_create_append_file
methods.description: Appends file content to TRX image.

methods.name: otrx_create_append_zeros
methods.description: Appends zeros to TRX image for padding.

methods.name: otrx_create_align
methods.description: Aligns current offset in TRX image.

methods.name: otrx_create_write_hdr
methods.description: Writes TRX header with CRC32 checksum.

methods.name: otrx_create
methods.description: Creates a new TRX file with specified partitions and padding.

methods.name: otrx_extract_copy
methods.description: Copies a partition from TRX file to output.

methods.name: otrx_extract
methods.description: Extracts specified partitions from a TRX file.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the utility.
